headline.title: 7 ways to travel smarter this summer, with help from Google
headline.summary: The article outlines seven strategies for smarter summer travel using Google tools and features. It emphasizes how these resources can enhance planning, navigation, and overall travel experiences.

articles.title: US-sanctioned currency exchange says $15 million heist done by "unfriendly states"
articles.summary: Grinex, a US-sanctioned currency exchange, reported a $15 million heist, attributing the attack to resources available only to "unfriendly states." The company claims that the sophistication of the hacking operation suggests state-sponsored involvement.

articles.title: Sam Altman’s project World looks to scale its human verification empire. First stop: Tinder.
articles.summary: Sam Altman's project World is aiming to expand its human verification services by partnering with platforms like Tinder. The initiative focuses on its Orb-centered anonymous verification system to enhance user trust and safety.

articles.title: Sources: Cursor in talks to raise $2B+ at $50B valuation as enterprise growth surges
articles.summary: Cursor is in discussions to raise over $2 billion at a valuation of $50 billion, driven by significant growth in its enterprise sector. The funding round is anticipated to be led by returning investors a16z and Thrive.

articles.title: OpenAI’s former Sora boss is leaving
articles.summary: Bill Peebles, the leader of OpenAI's Sora video generation team, has announced his departure from the company following the discontinuation of the Sora tool. This change is part of OpenAI's broader strategy to refocus its efforts and avoid distractions in its projects.

articles.title: Should you stare into Sam Altman’s orb before your next date?
articles.summary: Tinder is introducing a feature that allows users to verify their identity by visiting a facial scanning orb, co-founded by OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, in exchange for five free boosts on the app. This initiative is part of a broader trend of services adopting orb technology for identity verification.

articles.title: Anthropic’s new cybersecurity model could get it back in the government’s good graces
articles.summary: Anthropic's new cybersecurity model, Claude Mythos Preview, may help improve the company's relationship with the Trump administration, which has previously criticized it as a threat to national security. The model's focus on cybersecurity could potentially address concerns raised by the government, signaling a shift in dynamics.

articles.title: Kevin Weil and Bill Peebles exit OpenAI as company continues to shed ‘side quests’
articles.summary: Kevin Weil and Bill Peebles are departing from OpenAI as the company discontinues its Sora project and integrates its science team, indicating a strategic shift from consumer-focused initiatives to enterprise AI solutions. This move is part of OpenAI's broader effort to streamline operations and focus on core business objectives.

articles.title: ‘Tokenmaxxing’ is making developers less productive than they think
articles.summary: A new analysis reveals that the trend of 'tokenmaxxing' is leading developers to produce more code, but this increase is resulting in higher costs and necessitating extensive rewrites. As a consequence, overall developer productivity may be lower than perceived.

articles.title: Gazing Into Sam Altman’s Orb Now Proves You’re Human on Tinder
articles.summary: Tinder has introduced a new feature that requires users to verify their humanity by gazing into a virtual orb associated with OpenAI's Sam Altman. This initiative aims to enhance user authenticity and reduce the prevalence of bots on the platform.

articles.title: Dairy Queen is putting an AI chatbot in its drive-thrus
articles.summary: Dairy Queen is introducing an AI chatbot in its drive-thrus at multiple locations across the US and Canada to enhance service speed and encourage larger orders. The initiative is part of a broader trend among fast food chains to integrate AI technology into their operations.

articles.title: Tokenmaxxing, OpenAI’s shopping spree, and the AI Anxiety Gap
articles.summary: The article discusses the growing divide between AI industry insiders and the general public, highlighting OpenAI's recent acquisitions in various sectors and Anthropic's decision to withhold a powerful AI model from public release. It also notes how companies are rebranding and adapting to the AI landscape, reflecting increasing investment and concern within the field.
